description: Test prompts that verify rdk-system-config triggers and produces correct, board-family-aware configuration guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK user would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: s600-lock-cpu-max-freq
evals.prompt: S600 上怎么把 CPU 锁到最高频，一直跑在最大频率？
evals.expected_output: Lock via userspace governor + scaling_setspeed at 2100000 kHz; note S-series has no overclock and the setting resets on reboot.

assertions.text: Gives S600 max frequency 2100000 kHz (2.1 GHz) as the ceiling.
Uses userspace governor then writes scaling_setspeed (echo userspace > .../cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_governor, then echo 2100000 > .../policy0/scaling_setspeed).
States S-series has no boost/overclock, OR that the setting resets on reboot (persist via self-start).

evals.name: s100-fix-fan-speed
evals.prompt: S100 风扇老是变速，我想把风扇固定在最高档，怎么设置？
evals.expected_output: Set thermal_zone0 policy to user_space first, then echo 10 to cooling_device2/cur_state; warns step_wise overrides manual level.

assertions.text: Says the S100 fan is cooling_device2, bound to thermal_zone0.
Sets the zone policy to user_space FIRST (echo user_space > .../thermal_zone0/policy) before writing cur_state.
Writes the fan level via echo <0-10> > /sys/class/thermal/cooling_device2/cur_state and warns step_wise would override a manual value.

evals.name: s600-static-ip-cli
evals.prompt: 刚拿到 S600，想用命令行给有线网口配个静态 IP，怎么弄？
evals.expected_output: nmcli connection modify ipv4.method manual + addresses/gateway/dns, then down/up; no ifup/ifdown on S-series.

assertions.text: Uses nmcli connection modify with ipv4.method manual and ipv4.addresses/gateway, then nmcli connection down/up to apply.
States S-series (Ubuntu 24.04) does NOT support ifup/ifdown / editing /etc/network/interfaces.
Mentions the eth1 management port is fixed at 192.168.127.10, OR cautions not to lock yourself off the connected port.

evals.name: x5-config-txt-bus-toggle
evals.prompt: X5 想通过 config.txt 关掉 uart3、打开 i2c5，怎么写？
evals.expected_output: dtparam=uart3=off and dtparam=i2c5=on in /boot/config.txt (edit as root, reboot); mind X5 pin multiplexing; S-series uses fdt-enable instead.

assertions.text: Gives dtparam=uart3=off and dtparam=i2c5=on in /boot/config.txt (edit as root, reboot to apply).
Warns about X5 pin multiplexing (a row shares pins, only one function active; e.g. uart3 vs i2c5, spi2 vs pwm).
Does NOT claim S-series uses dtparam; if S is mentioned, says S uses fdt-enable/fdt-disable instead.

evals.name: s-series-no-soft-ap
evals.prompt: S100 能不能开个 WiFi 热点（Soft AP）让别的设备连？
evals.expected_output: S-series Soft AP is documented as not yet available; do not hand a hostapd recipe; offer Station/wired alternatives.

assertions.text: States that on S-series, Wi-Fi Soft AP mode is not yet available per the official doc.
Does NOT provide an S-series hostapd / isc-dhcp-server AP setup as if it works.
Optionally notes that Soft AP (incl. X5 5G) is an X-series capability, or suggests Station mode / wired as alternatives.
